lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the primary torso mass, with decreased intervals between the final three lines on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first line posterior to the neck is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso. The 10th and 11th vertical markers consist of discontinuous, dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 3 to 4 distinct white spots is positioned on the upper hind limb, posterior to the primary vertical line sequence.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots located on the mid-posterior haunch align to form a short horizontal geometric orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white crescent-shaped patch on the ventral-lateral throat; white chevron marking on the facial bridge between the eyes; white spots visible on the carpus and tarsus joints.
